title: Sample 4: Banned Terms & ₹299 Price
notes: Recorded without provider credentials: gates, citation verifier, consensus and scoring ran for real; the two LLM reviewers were not called, so soft-category findings (tone, messaging) are absent.

post.caption: Grab these cheap used jeans for only ₹299! Fresh lot of old clothes ready for pickup at Bandra. #ThriftIt
post.altText: Pair of washed vintage jeans laid flat on neutral background

findings.clauseQuote: The following terms are strictly banned in all customer-facing text: "cheap", "junk", "old clothes", "second-hand" (in captions; permitted only in alt text or hashtags), and "used" as a garment quality descriptor
findings.explanation: Use approved positive descriptors such as 'pre-loved' or 'curated' instead of derogatory terms like cheap or junk.
